def solve_cvrp(instance):
    depot = instance["depot_index"]
    customers = list(instance["customer_ids"])
    demands = instance["demands"]
    capacity = instance["capacity"]
    matrix = instance["distance_matrix"]
    n_hint = instance.get("vehicle_count_hint", None)

    def route_load(r):
        s = 0
        for v in r:
            s += demands[v]
        return s

    def route_cost(r):
        if not r:
            return 0
        c = matrix[depot][r[0]] + matrix[r[-1]][depot]
        for i in range(len(r) - 1):
            c += matrix[r[i]][r[i + 1]]
        return c

    # Build feasible initial solution (singletons)
    routes = []
    pos_in_route = {}
    for v in customers:
        idx = len(routes)
        routes.append([v])
        pos_in_route[v] = (idx, 0)

    # Clarke-Wright savings merges (end-to-start with deterministic orientations)
    savings = []
    mcount = len(customers)
    for ii in range(mcount):
        a = customers[ii]
        da = matrix[depot][a]
        for jj in range(ii + 1, mcount):
            b = customers[jj]
            s = da + matrix[depot][b] - matrix[a][b]
            savings.append((s, da + matrix[depot][b], a, b))
    savings.sort(key=lambda x: (x[0], -x[1], -x[2], -x[3]), reverse=True)

    for item in savings:
        _, _, i, j = item
        if i not in pos_in_route or j not in pos_in_route:
            continue
        ra, _ = pos_in_route[i]
        rb, _ = pos_in_route[j]
        if ra == rb:
            continue
        r_a = routes[ra]
        r_b = routes[rb]

        ia = pos_in_route[i][1]
        ib = pos_in_route[j][1]

        i_is_start = (ia == 0)
        i_is_end = (ia == len(r_a) - 1)
        j_is_start = (ib == 0)
        j_is_end = (ib == len(r_b) - 1)

        # Determine best feasible merge orientation by exact cost delta for depot connections not needed
        # Only consider end-to-start style merges.
        best_new = None
        best_delta = None

        def cost_of_concat(left, right):
            # cost(left) + cost(right) - depot-left_end - right_start-depot + left_end-right_start
            if not left or not right:
                return route_cost(left) + route_cost(right)
            left_cost = matrix[depot][left[0]] + matrix[left[-1]][depot]
            for t in range(len(left) - 1):
                left_cost += matrix[left[t]][left[t + 1]]
            right_cost = matrix[depot][right[0]] + matrix[right[-1]][depot]
            for t in range(len(right) - 1):
                right_cost += matrix[right[t]][right[t + 1]]
            merged_cost = (matrix[depot][left[0]] + matrix[left[-1]][depot])  # placeholder; we will compute directly
            merged_cost = matrix[depot][left[0]]
            for t in range(len(left) - 1):
                merged_cost += matrix[left[t]][left[t + 1]]
            merged_cost += matrix[left[-1]][right[0]]
            for t in range(len(right) - 1):
                merged_cost += matrix[right[t]][right[t + 1]]
            merged_cost += matrix[right[-1]][depot]
            return merged_cost

        load_a = route_load(r_a)
        load_b = route_load(r_b)

        # Merge candidates:
        # end(i)+start(j): r_a + r_b
        if i_is_end and j_is_start and load_a + load_b <= capacity:
            newr = r_a + r_b
            best_new, best_delta = newr, (route_cost(newr) - (route_cost(r_a) + route_cost(r_b)))
        # start(i)+end(j): r_b + r_a
        if i_is_start and j_is_end and load_a + load_b <= capacity:
            newr = r_b + r_a
            d = route_cost(newr) - (route_cost(r_a) + route_cost(r_b))
            if best_new is None or d < best_delta:
                best_new, best_delta = newr, d
        # start(i)+start(j): reverse a then end-to-start
        if i_is_start and j_is_start and load_a + load_b <= capacity:
            newr = list(reversed(r_a)) + r_b
            d = route_cost(newr) - (route_cost(r_a) + route_cost(r_b))
            if best_new is None or d < best_delta:
                best_new, best_delta = newr, d
        # end(i)+end(j): reverse b then end-to-start
        if i_is_end and j_is_end and load_a + load_b <= capacity:
            newr = r_a + list(reversed(r_b))
            d = route_cost(newr) - (route_cost(r_a) + route_cost(r_b))
            if best_new is None or d < best_delta:
                best_new, best_delta = newr, d

        if best_new is None:
            continue

        # Accept only if it improves or is not too worse to keep determinism stable
        if best_delta is not None and best_delta <= 1e-9:
            routes[ra] = best_new
            routes[rb] = []
            for k, v in enumerate(best_new):

            if n_hint is not None:

                for r in routes:
                    if r:
                        active += 1
                if active <= max(1, int(n_hint)):

    # Intra-route 2-opt (deterministic first-improvement per route)
    def two_opt_improve(r):
        if len(r) < 4:
            return r
        best = r
        best_cost = route_cost(best)
        improved = True
        while improved:
            improved = False
            m = len(best)
            for i in range(m - 3):
                a = best[i]
                b = best[i + 1]
                for k in range(i + 2, m - 1):
                    c = best[k]
                    d = best[k + 1]
                    cur = matrix[a][b] + matrix[c][d]
                    new = matrix[a][c] + matrix[b][d]
                    if new < cur:
                        cand = best[:i + 1] + list(reversed(best[i + 1:k + 1])) + best[k + 1:]
                        cand_cost = best_cost - cur + new
                        if cand_cost + 1e-9 < best_cost:
                            best = cand
                            best_cost = cand_cost
                            improved = True
                            break
                if improved:
                    break
        return best

    def find_best_insert(route_to, node):
        load_to = route_load(route_to)
        if load_to + demands[node] > capacity:
            return None
        best_pos = None
        best_delta = None
        m = len(route_to)
        for pos in range(-1, m):
            if pos == -1:
                old = matrix[depot][route_to[0]] if m > 0 else matrix[depot][depot]
                new = matrix[depot][node] + matrix[node][route_to[0]] if m > 0 else matrix[depot][node] + matrix[node][depot]
